$comment: Registry sources (v1.1). sbti (Phase 11, ADR-026): the SBTi Target Dashboard companies export, read through the cached fetcher (ttlHours) and matched with the ADR-019 equality rule on company_name, or by ISIN/LEI equality with the Wikidata entity. A 'Commitment Removed' status whose status_reason items are all in neutralReasons is a status note (0 points), not the brand walking back. maxPossible bounds the 'possible match' lines per run. Points and multipliers live in config/weights.json, never here. sabin (Phase 13, ADR-028): the Sabin Center Climate Litigation Database on www.climatecasechart.com. The adapter reads only server-rendered /document/<slug> and /geographies/<slug> pages (never /_search, never the app's private API). countrySlugs maps the Wikidata P17 country label to the site's geography slug; the US page is always read as well. maxCases bounds the case pages read per run (seed index entries first, then geography listings whose title names the brand).

neutralReasons: Target set at parent company level
